ambiguities_or_notes: The awkward source address construction around ‘Милостивый Государь Андрей Александрович’ is normalized only enough to read as direct address in English.
поминать меня is rendered ‘mention me’ rather than the more literary ‘name me,’ preserving the practical publication context.
статья is rendered ‘piece’ because Tolstoy has just withdrawn the specific promise of The Novel of a Russian Landowner and now promises an unspecified contribution.
The postscript about leaving for Moscow for 28 days remains after the signature as in the source; all three editorial-note items are retained, including the final dash-only item.
